run.label: LIVE — Muse Wonder
run.text: Allocate substitute material is selected: it recovers all 70 impacted units in 35 hours for $3,115, using 70 of the 100 verified substitute units on hand while the held lot remains unavailable because its certificate shows 120 each against 80 each received, a 40-unit discrepancy. Completing in 35 hours protects the earliest 36-hour due point. Waiting for replenishment costs nothing extra but finishes in 83 hours, missing both due points after a 48-hour replenishment lead. Splitting capacity finishes faster in 17.5 hours but costs $3,202.50, $87.50 more than allocation, so the added speed is not justified here. This uses current certificate, receiving and stock quantities and the cell hourly rates in this snapshot, and assumes substitute allocation draws only from verified available stock.

Allocate Substitute restores production from verified substitute stock of 100 each, completing all 70 units in 35 hours for $3,115 in labor and material premium while held lot stays on hold. Selection assumes quantities use current certificate, receiving and stock records, cell costs use snapshot hourly rates, and substitute allocation uses only verified available stock with no supplier messaging.
